# Working rules for this program (generated by the blr-app-builder skill)

- Stack: Next.js static export (`out/`) loaded by Electron through the private `app://` protocol; data in `node:sqlite`
  inside the main process; the page talks to it ONLY through `window.bridge` (electron/preload.js) -> IPC -> `{ok,data}`.
- Add a module = store action + page + dictionary keys (ar,en,fr) + NAV entry + permission + test. Copy `src/app/items/`.
- Every UI string goes through `t("key")`; every key is `[ar, en, fr]` in `src/lib/dict.ts`. `npm test` enforces it.
- Money: `formatNumber()` (LRI/PDI isolated). Numbers from inputs: `num()`. Dates: local ISO strings (`todayIso()`).
- Do NOT edit `bader-license/device-id.js` or `license.js` (changing them invalidates every customer's license).
  Only `license-config.js` (+ the `app_name` title in guard.js). Each program has its own `product_id`.
- Never put `build/icon.png`, `public/` or `package-lock.json` in `.gitignore`.
- Before finishing: `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`, then the browser + Electron e2e from the skill.
